edge.subject: MetaCyc:CPLX-8177
edge.description: GalA catalyzes gallate ring cleavage. The 2005 recombinant preparation supports the activity; its late product analysis alone does not resolve the immediate keto/enol product. Exact formal reaction chemistry also requires the native/Rhea and 2011 reconciliation.

evidence.source_assertion: ENZRXN-18371 connects enzyme CPLX-8177 to GALLATE-DIOXYGENASE-RXN and records a purified heterologous-host assay with PMID16030014.
Table 1 lists 42.7 micromol/min/mg for gallate dioxygenase in the final phenyl-Sepharose fraction from E. coli carrying pETGalA.
evidence.source_locator: Table 1, p.35385, title and row 3/specific activity; retained rest1 transcript L1212-L1233

endpoint_qualifiers.description: KT2440 GalA expressed from pETGalA in E. coli BL21(DE3). The encoded chain has 420 residues; Edman sequencing indicated apparent initiator-Met removal, giving a 419-residue processed chain. The complete recombinant sequence and any other terminal changes were not established here.
